## Purpose

Describe the change and link the relevant issue.

## Scope and evidence

- What contracts, model/runtime boundaries, or user-facing behavior change?
- What tests and documentation were updated? Include the commands and results.
- Does this affect privacy, security, resource use, licensing, or deployment? Explain.

## Public-data check

- [ ] No real plate images/text, private weights, datasets, secrets, internal reports, or absolute local paths are included.
- [ ] Any example uses fictional synthetic data.
- [ ] No unsupported accuracy or production claim was added.
